# scrape-smart-wallets

> Browser console scripts that extract smart money wallets, KOL wallets, token rankings, radar signals, and DEX trades from gmgn.ai.

scrape-smart-wallets is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
